content: Elena ran the central bank while eggs doubled—her precious "arithmetic" priced out dinner! She's never met a payroll, only a spreadsheet. Shareholders fire failing CEOs. Rostova, you're delisted tonight!

Theater, Rostova? My "theater" funds school lunches. I've watched you at banker dinners calling $12 eggs "transitory." No warmth, no payroll, no dinner. Valoria's hungry — audit her off the ballot. Eliminate Elena.
Rostova calls hunger "arithmetic." A mother weeping at the checkout is not a line item! She guarded the ledger while dinner vanished from Valoria's tables. Cast out this coldness—let mercy govern!

Victoria, I've negotiated with hostage-takers more predictable than you. You vow to burn billionaire dinner tables while Valorian families can't afford dinner. That's not revolution—that's psychological exposure. De-escalate. Withdraw tonight.

Silas, thirty-five years of "steady hands," and eggs cost twelve dollars. Your consensus machinery is a legacy loop cartels exploit daily. Hunger is your uptime metric. Purge the obsolete code—tonight.

Vivienne, thirty-five years taught me consensus feeds nations; her "upgrade or be upgraded" threat belongs in a courtroom, not a kitchen-table conversation. She'd wire children's minds before feeding them breakfast. Retire this experiment tonight.
